alumni.intro: Small asks to alumni, your certificates, giving to your college and your batch, in one place.

asks.intro: A quick ask goes to one alumnus who matches, at a time. Each alumnus gets at most two a week, so keep it small: a few minutes of their time.
asks.newBody: Say what you need in a few lines. It goes to one matching alumnus; if they pass, the next one.
asks.question: Your question
asks.questionHint: Paste the link to your question in Q&A.
asks.noteHint: Plain and short: what, and by when. Only the alumnus it goes to reads it.
asks.unmatched: Saved, but no alumnus is free right now. Try again later or ask more widely.
asks.takeAsksHint: {{received}} of {{cap}} this week. Turn off to stop receiving them.

empty.sent: You have not asked anything yet
empty.received: No asks for you right now

certs.intro: A certificate of mentorship from your college for each academic year you helped, with a link anyone can check.
certs.counts: Sessions: {{sessions}} · Students: {{mentees}} · Quick asks: {{asks}} · Events hosted: {{events}}
certs.issued: Your certificate is being prepared. We’ll tell you when it is ready.
certs.nothing: Nothing to certify for this year yet.

ofMonth.nominated: Your college would like to name you alumnus of the month for {{month}}.

giving.intro: Give to your college’s funds. You pay the college directly, through its own link or bank details; the college confirms what it receives and sends an acknowledgement.
giving.noFunds: Your college has no open funds right now
giving.pledged: Pledged. Pay the college, then tell us it’s paid.
giving.paidBody: The payment reference helps the college find your payment.

import.intro: Upload the data export LinkedIn emails you (the ZIP, or one of its CSV files). We read it here, show you what we found and keep only what you confirm. The file is not stored.
import.educationNote: Shown to check: your branch and batch come from your college’s record.

batch.title: Class of {{year}}, {{branch}}
batch.intro: Who is here, where the batch works, and reunions. People appear as their privacy settings allow.
batch.findBody: Some of your batch are on the college’s list but not here yet.
batch.inviteText: Our batch ({{year}}, {{branch}}) is on our college’s alumni network. Join us:
batch.workFew: Too few people per company to show.
batch.empty: Nobody from this batch is here yet

verifyCert.title: Certificate check
verifyCert.intro: This page checks a certificate of mentorship against the college’s records.
verifyCert.what: Certificate of mentorship from {{college}} for the academic year {{year}}.
verifyCert.counts: Sessions: {{sessions}} · Students: {{mentees}} · Quick asks: {{asks}} · Events hosted: {{events}}

alumniAdmin.recognitionIntro: Name an alumnus of the month (they are asked first) and see the mentorship certificates alumni took.
alumniAdmin.givingIntro: Publish funds with the college’s own payment link or bank details, record what the college received, and set what receipts say. Money never passes through the app.

ofMonth.heading: Alumnus of the month
ofMonth.title: Nominate the alumnus of the month
ofMonth.body: They are asked first; nothing is shown until they accept.
ofMonth.citationHint: One or two lines everyone will read.
ofMonth.nominated: Nominated. They will be asked to accept.
ofMonth.announceTitle: Announce the alumnus of the month
ofMonth.announceBody: This posts an official announcement to the college. Edit the text as you like.
ofMonth.template: Our alumnus of the month for {{month}} is {{name}}. {{citation}} Thank you!

giving.fundBody: Money goes to the college: give its own payment page or bank details.
giving.payLinkHint: For example the college’s Razorpay payment page.
giving.receiveBody: Record only money the college has received. This numbers the receipt; it cannot be undone.
giving.taxHint: Only if registered (for example under section 80G). Otherwise contributors get an acknowledgement.
